headline: Haplotype-resolved chromosome-scale genomes of pomegranate and tetraploid wheat
label: Chromosome Scale Genome Assemblies
summary: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies now link polyploid crop genome structure to domestication traits and GWAS loci.
synthesis: The dominant thread is haplotype-resolved, chromosome-scale genome assembly in crop species. The 'Wonderful' pomegranate genome was phased from 11 pollen haploid gametes using the Hapi R package. A Timopheevii wheat preprint presents genomic resources for the lineage, reporting homoeologous exchange in zhukovskys wheat and mosaic haplotypes in domesticated forms. The tetraploid wheat graph pangenome, built from 12 de novo genomes and 736 accessions, extends this to population scale, linking structural variants, the Btr1-A allele and 287 GWAS loci to domestication and diversity. What is new is the coupling of haplotype-resolved structure with trait association across accessions; the pomegranate and Timopheevii items remain single-genome or single-lineage resource reports.
